notes.title: Double Cheese Burger Update! (1.2)
notes.notes:
http://tof.canardpc.com/view/9e6e27a4-5718-45fb-abd6-132a7f061d9d.jpg

This is the second update for Verlies II! The game becomes completely moddable, all graphics and sound files are replaceable! You can now create a total conversion for Verlies II.

Major update:
- The game becomes completely moddable!

Minor update:
- Added a "fast dice game" option
- Added a "skip intro" option
- Added a "how to play" option
- Added a "fast restart" option when you die
- Added a sound control option

Improvement:
- The functions "restart" relaunches the game directly in the start city with your previous character
- Loading time at launch is reduced on some configs

Balancing:
- Nepheron can not exceed 666 HP

notes.title: Little Kitty Update! (1.1)
notes.notes:
http://tof.canardpc.com/view/ac86f107-d059-4215-9bba-adbe174314c6.jpg

I am pleased to announce the first update of Verlies II!

Major update:
- Added a "Little soft kitty" mode for the most fragile players (but no achievements progressions unlocks, cowards)

Minor update:
- All cutscenes and transitions scenes are now skippable by pressing a button (you can now start a game in 10 seconds against 40 before)
- Added a "restart game" option
- Added a "help me" option

Balancing:
- "Ice breath" magic nerfed
- Concentration skill is more powerful but are only active in fight

Bugs fixes:
- Fixed a bug that did not save the "full screen" option
- Fixed a bug when trying to transform the final boss in frog (what disrespect anyway!)
- Fixed a bug when trying to steal and hit at the same time
- Fixed a bug that allowed to open chests in fight
- Fixed several minor bugs
- Fixed some bugs that can cause crashes
